content: Tola andǝ Jayir
Anzǝm lú mala Abimale ka, Tola muna-ɓwabura mala Puwa, mǝ'kà Dodo, a tàu mala Isaka, lo ace amsǝ amǝ Isǝrayila. Yì Tola ka, do a Shamir aɓa nzali múr-ankono mala Ifǝrem.
Yì ka, duk kasǝla amúr amǝ Isǝrayila apǝlǝa lumi-ɓari-nong-tàrú, sǝ yi wú. À tsǝì a Shamir.
Anzǝm Tola ka, Jayir ɓwa Gilǝyat lo, sǝ duk kasǝla amúr amǝ Isǝrayila apǝlǝa lumi-ɓari-nong-ɓari.
Jayir ndanǝ amuna-burana lumi-tàrú mǝnana à kǝ gya a nzǝm amǝdambǝriso lumi-tàrú ka, sǝ à yálmúr alá lumi-tàrú a Gilǝyat. À kǝ tunǝ amǝno yì alá ka ama Havot-Jayir
bà yalung.
Jayir paklú sǝ à tsǝkbani a Kamon.
Amǝ'Amon andǝ amǝ'Filisti par amǝ'Isǝrayila
Amǝ Isǝrayila pàk gìr mǝɓike ɗǝm, a sǝne mala Yahweh.
À peri aban aBa'al andǝ Ashtarot, aɓakuli mala amǝ'Suriya, andǝ aɓakuli mala amǝ'Sidon, andǝ aɓakuli mala amǝ'Mowap, andǝ aɓakuli mala amǝ'Amon, andǝ aɓakuli mala amǝ'Filisti.
À vwakibuia arǝ Yahweh, sǝ à nying peri abani.
Nda bumlulla mala Yahweh earke amúr amǝ Isǝrayila, sǝ tasǝia a ɓabù amǝ'Filisti andǝ amǝ'Amon
ngga.

Amǝ'Filisti andǝ amǝ'Amon par amǝ Isǝrayila sǝ à betia aɓa pǝlǝa mǝno. À par amǝ Isǝrayila ba apǝlǝa lum-bwamdǝ-tongno-nong-tàrú, yià amǝ Isǝrayila mǝnana kat à ndanǝdo a takuli mala Jodan, a nzali mala amǝ'Amor, mǝnana nda aɓa Gilǝyat ka.
Pǝlǝa amǝ'Amon gbal ka à yàlî Nggeasala Jodan ace kánǝ munǝo arǝ amǝ'tàu mala Yahuda, andǝ amǝ'tàu mala Benjami, sǝ arǝ ɓala-kàu mala Ifǝrem. Amǝ Isǝrayila tanni kǝ̀rkǝ́r.
Nda amǝ Isǝrayila ɓua aban Yahweh ama: <<Sǝm pàngŋǝ́nò cauɓikea. Sǝm pǝlǝna nzǝm sǝm arǝò, we Ɓakuli ma'sǝm, sǝ sǝm kpanata aBa'al.>>
Sǝ Yahweh earî amǝ Isǝrayila ama, <<Ən amsǝ wun a ɓabù amǝ'Masar, andǝ amǝ'Amor, andǝ amǝ'Amon, andǝ amǝ'Filisti re?
Ɗǝm ngga lang amǝ'Sidon, andǝ amǝ'Amalek, andǝ amǝ'Mawon
par wun aɓata tanni, sǝ wu ɓua abanam ngga, ǝn amsǝ wun a ɓabuia.
Sǝ kat andǝ mǝno ka, wu pǝlǝ nzǝm wun arǝàm, wu kpata aɓea aɓakuli. Acemani ka, pà Mǝ nǝ amsǝ wun ɗǝm ɗàng.
Wu kyane, wu kya ɓua aban aɓakuli mǝnana wu twal ka; ɓǝà amsǝ wun a pwari mǝnana wu kùtí aɓa tanni ka.>>
Sǝ amǝ Isǝrayila zǝmbî Yahweh ama, <<Sǝm pàngŋǝ̀nà cauɓikea. Pàk gìr mǝnana kat a kǝ sǝni nda pepè awu nǝ pangnǝ sǝm ngga, sǝama, ida amsǝ sǝm yalung.>>
Nda amǝ Isǝrayila pusǝki abǝri ɓakuli mǝnana aɓalǝia ka, à sukkia, sǝ à peri aban Yahweh ka. A masǝlǝate ka,
Yahweh yi aulǝ nǝ sǝn tanni mǝɓike mǝnana amǝ Isǝrayila kǝ nu ka.
Amǝ'lwa mala amǝ'Amon ram rǝia abanɓwáná, sǝ à kya tsǝk kàttì malea aɓa Gilǝyat; amǝ Isǝrayila gbal ka, à ram rǝia abanɓwáná sǝ à kya tsǝk kàttì malea a Mizpa aɓa Gilǝyat.
Aɓwana-mǝgule amur Gilǝyat
ne arǝarǝia ama, <<Ɓwa mana nǝ̀ tita kánǝ munǝo arǝ amǝ'Amon ngga, ɓwê na nǝ̀ duk múrû amúr aɓwana puppup mǝnana ndanǝdo a Gilǝyat ka.>>
